Specification: This specification models the N-process Peterson mutual exclusion algorithm as a PlusCal algorithm translated into TLA+. Each process repeatedly cycles through noncritical section, entry protocol, critical section, and exit, using the shared arrays level and last_to_enter to coordinate access to the critical section. The file defines the initial state, one action per translated control location, a combined Next action over all processes, and a simple temporal specification Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars; it does not include explicit fairness, liveness, or proof obligations.
IfThenElse: IF l[self] < (N-1) THEN /\ level' = [level EXCEPT ![self] = l[self]] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter2"] /\ l' = l ELSE /\ l' = [l EXCEPT ![self] = 0] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cs"] /\ level' = level

IF k[self] < N THEN /\ IF (k[self] /= self) /\ (level[k[self]] >= l[self]) THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter4"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter6"] /\ UNCHANGED << l, k >> ELSE /\ l' = [l EXCEPT ![self] = l[self] + 1] /\ k' = [k EXCEPT ![self] = 0] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter"]
IF (k[self] /= self) /\ (level[k[self]] >= l[self]) THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter4"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter6"]
IF last_to_enter[l[self]] = self THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter5"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter6"]
